The issuer shows moderate operating profitability (EBIT margin ~14%) but relatively thin bottom-line profitability (net margin ~2.7%), which limits earnings resilience. Balance-sheet leverage is moderate (liabilities are ~57% of assets) and liquidity is only slightly above break-even (current ratio ~1.14), supporting a mid-to-lower investment-grade view.  

DECISION: BBB-
